query:
SELECT observacoes, ROUND(SUM(valor), 2) as total
FROM lancamento_custo
WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001
AND (
  observacoes LIKE '%QMD 0H48%' OR observacoes LIKE '%QMO6E54%' OR observacoes LIKE '%QMD0H48%'
  OR observacoes LIKE '%QMN1F10%' OR observacoes LIKE '%SETOR RH%' OR observacoes LIKE '%RRH 9F10%'
  OR observacoes LIKE '%TNW 2I60%'
)
GROUP BY observacoes
ORDER BY total DESC
